After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. However, as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.
